intro: The Maldives is a presidential republic, with an elected president who leads the government.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years and leads the government. The People's Majlis is the parliament. President Mohamed Muizzu took office in 2023.

chapters.title: A voice on climate
text: The Maldives speaks out loudly on climate change, since its survival depends on it.
